mentions.name: tsz
mentions.description: A performance-first TypeScript checker written in Rust, aiming for full tsc compatibility with additional soundness. It has reached a 99.8% tsc conformance test pass rate, and single-file benchmarks run 3-5x faster than tsgo.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on tsz (https://tsz.dev)

a performance-first TypeScript checker written in Rust. Started 5 months ago and it's been mostly AI-written code.
99.8% tsc conformance test pass rate today. Single file benchmarks are 3–5x faster than tsgo.
